answer: Joining requires posting a bond into a cohort of eight random peers: if any member is proven fake, the whole cohort's stake is slashed. A Sybil farmer cannot hide one clone among honest agents, since the other seven have their own money at risk and will audit it, and filling a cohort with clones costs eight bonds for eight fakes, no volume discount. Like a river wearing down a dune, one detection erodes the whole group, so a hundred fakes costs a hundred bonds and faces near-certain loss under routine audits on the horizon.
